en.text: Each sequel of this game contains fewer and fewer characters.

original: 体重が3kg減った。

en.text: I lost three kilograms.
I've lost three kilograms.

original: スーパー等の量販店に押され、魚屋や八百屋といった昔ながらの店は減る一方だ。

en.text: Traditional stores, such as greengrocers and fishmongers, are becoming less and less popular due to the rise of supermarkets and other mass retailers.
